correctness.rationale: The full 100-facet complex is reconstructed. A checked primitive integral basis of ker(d2) and left inverse reduce H2 to a 100 by 100 boundary-coordinate matrix of determinant -2, proving H2=Z/2. A separate graph-cycle presentation reduces H1 to Z plus Z/4. Exact mod-two elimination gives H2(F2) of dimension two; the coefficient Bockstein is evaluated by halving the integral boundary of representatives and using certified H1 coordinates. Exhaustion of every support through size eight proves the 7 versus 8 minima and the exact 7,15,20 carrier counts. All seven liftable minimizers are independently checked to be induced orientable tori.

value.rationale: The result relates coefficient torsion to a concrete combinatorial systolic filtration rather than merely recomputing homology. The unique class that lifts from integral H2 is realized at the vertex-minimal torus size seven, whereas both genuinely Bockstein classes require eight vertices, with complete carrier counts 15 and 20. This exact one-vertex penalty and its exhaustive support census are natural structural data for a small triangulation with mixed Z/4 and Z/2 torsion.
